fact: MTN Group's CEO announced MTN Cameroon network investment of 62.4 billion XAF (USD 100 million) for 2025 and 187.2 billion XAF over three years, including AI and data centres.
title: Ralph Mupita, PDG de MTN Group, annonce un investissement de 62,4 milliards de F.Cfa au Cameroun en 2025 pour améliorer la qualité de service
